c277fd563613cda6767258838574386d16e830eb.summary: The Swiss government CERT (GovCERT) analysed Fobber, a new e-banking Trojan that appears to be a spinoff of Tinba, to check whether Swiss critical infrastructure was targeted. Highlights include function-level encryption that keeps code encrypted until it is called, position-independent code, and hash-based import resolution. The report says the samples it examined seem to share one campaign key. It knows of no Swiss financial institutions targeted so far.

The report says some of its own claims could not be verified.

c2fe4faed629239ed3b7bd3c8f9f8ac0342f8e70.summary: SentinelOne reports a new variant of Operation In(ter)ception, a macOS campaign it links to the North-Korean linked Lazarus group (aka Nukesped). Lures use job vacancies at a rival cryptocurrency exchange, following a Coinbase-themed variant that ESET spotted in August 2022. The malware uses a persistence agent, a second-stage app and a downloader with hardcoded C2. The C2 was offline during analysis, so the final payload was not retrieved.

c25c04b4b91f0b4b010a1c30451bd9ecf702c094.summary: Trend Micro reports on Kasseika ransomware, which uses bring-your-own-vulnerable-driver (BYOVD) attacks. It abuses the signed Martini.sys driver from VirIT Agent System to terminate at least 991 antivirus and security-related processes, and runs PsExec to deploy batch scripts. Initial access is through targeted phishing. The report says indicators resemble BlackMatter ransomware and that the BlackMatter source code appears to have been used. c2cfe60bb82e25bca1622cf08d1e2fb5fd582dcf.summary: Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN), a health system in eastern Pennsylvania, says it was hit by the BlackCat ransomware-as-a-service group, also known as Alphv. The IT team detected unauthorized activity on Feb. 6. The attack so far affected the network supporting one physician practice in Lackawanna County, and operations continued normally. LVHN refused BlackCat's ransom payment demand. A US HHS alert said ransom demands reached $1.5 million and affiliates keep 80% to 90% of payments. Investigation details were still emerging.
